preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 1 and 1,000,000.
The number of edges m must be between 1 and 1,000,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= n and 1 <= b_i <= n and a_i != b_i for a_i, b_i in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge must connect two distinct vertices within the range of 1 to n.

postconditions.description: The number of selected vertices must match the output count k.

postconditions.expression: all(any((x, y) in edges or any((x, z) in edges and (z, y) in edges for z in range(1, n + 1)) for x in selected_vertices) for y in range(1, n + 1) if y not in selected_vertices)
postconditions.description: Every vertex not in the selected set must be reachable from at least one vertex in the selected set in at most two moves.

postconditions.expression: all(x != y for x in selected_vertices for y in selected_vertices)
postconditions.description: All selected vertices must be distinct.
